title: Anytime-Valid Inference in Conjoint Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2610.28979v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Choosing an appropriate sample size is a fundamental challenge in experimental design. This challenge is particularly salient in conjoint experiments, where researchers simultaneously target many estimands whose inferential goals may be reached at different sample sizes. Conventional sample-size calculations address this challenge in an ex ante manner. In large online studies, including many conjoint experiments, data often arrive continuously, allowing researchers to dynamically stop data collection. In such settings, the relevant practical question is not "what sample size should I choose in advance?" but rather, as data accumulate, "have I learned enough yet?" A naive response is to repeatedly inspect conventional confidence intervals and $p$-values, but doing so invalidates their inferential guarantees. translated_title: 联合实验中的随时有效推断
translated_abstract: 选择合适的样本量是实验设计中的一个根本性挑战。这一挑战在联合实验中尤为突出，因为研究者会同时关注多个估计量，而其推断目标可能在不同的样本量下才能达成。传统的样本量计算是以“事前”的方式来应对这一挑战的。在大型在线研究（包括许多联合实验）中，数据通常是连续到达的，这使得研究者可以动态地停止数据收集。在这种情境下，实际需要回答的问题不再是“我应该事先选择多大的样本量？”，而是随着数据的不断积累，“我是否已经学到了足够的信息？”一种朴素的做法是反复查看传统的置信区间和 p 值，但这样做会使它们原有的推断保证失效。我们通过为联合实验开发一个通用的“随时有效”框架来应对这一挑战，该框架允许对数据收集进行持续监控并保持有效的统计推断。
tldr: 该论文为联合实验提出了一个通用的“随时有效”推断框架，使研究者能够在数据持续积累过程中进行持续监控并动态决定停止数据收集的时机，同时不破坏统计推断的有效性。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a general anytime-valid inference framework for conjoint experiments, enabling researchers to continuously monitor accumulating data and dynamically stop data collection without invalidating statistical guarantees.
